{
  "status": "needs_clarification",
  "rationale": "The request mandates evaluating two distinct layer orders (Air/SiO2/TiO2/Glass and Air/TiO2/SiO2/Glass) within a single optimization context. The bounded TMM task schema supports optimizing one fixed stack sequence per experiment. To proceed, please specify which of the two orders is the primary candidate for this draft, or confirm if you require two separate experiments to be generated.",
  "normalized_request_english": "Design a planar two-layer antireflection coating on a semi-infinite glass substrate (n=1.52) with air incidence using lossless SiO2 (n=1.46) and TiO2 (n=2.40). Optimize thicknesses between 40 nm and 160 nm to minimize mean reflectance at normal incidence s-polarization over 450-700 nm. Target mean reflectance < 0.03. Use deterministic TMM, seed 17, max 64 solver evaluations.",
  "experiments": [],
  "uncertainty": {
    "thickness_sigma_nm": 1.0,
    "thickness_error_model": "absolute_normal",
    "thickness_relative_fraction": 0.0,
    "thickness_samples": 16,
    "angle_perturbation_deg": 0.0,
    "material_dataset_policy": "resolved_only",
    "maximum_material_scenarios": 8,
    "random_seed": 42
  }
}
